calls.statement:
SELECT 
  m.home_store_id,
  s.store_name,
  COUNT(*) as new_members_2025
FROM dim_member m
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON (m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = true)
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM m.join_date) = 2025
  AND m.is_current = true
GROUP BY m.home_store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY m.home_store_id

SELECT home_store_id, COUNT(*) as count
FROM dim_member
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM join_date) = 2025
  AND is_current = true
GROUP BY home_store_id
ORDER BY home_store_id

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_new_members_2025
FROM dim_member
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM join_date) = 2025
  AND is_current = true
